description: Transmits DTM packets continuously while measuring DTM TX current draw via PPK2.
help_text:
📡 [PPK2 DTM TX Power Guide]

1. Target TX Power: 0 ~ +10 dBm
2. Max Allowed Current: <= 15.0 mA PASS
3. Setup: Configure Target DUT Control Port in top toolbar (19200 bps), place PPK2 Interface Config on dashboard, then run this card
4. Verdict: Current limit is compared against the average, not the peak
name: DTM TX Current Measurement Using PPK2
